place._theme: Quiet sites with residents; here they are the people being defended, so the words keep them alive.

prose.name: Defense: Raiders at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Raiders are due back at the <Place> tonight, and the volunteer who posted the job is thrilled anyone answered.
prose.card: Local Contract. Hold the <Place> on <Planet> against raiders. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: Raiders came at the <Place> three times and didn't get in. The volunteer who called me in was still delighted about it an hour later.
say: That's them gone! And it's only half past, so there's still time for tea!

broadcast: Okay! So they're coming back tonight, probably around dark, which is loads of time, and we've done sandwiches and the kettle's on, so if you could just stand where they come in and be very loud at them that would be brilliant!
